title: Evaluation of State Integrals at Rational Points
container-title: Communications in Number Theory and Physics
note: arXiv:1411.6062, Comm. Number Theory Phys. 9 (2015) 549-582. Added 2026-07-17 from library/arxiv-1411.6062v2/1411.6062v2.pdf. Multi-dimensional state-integrals of Faddeev quantum dilogarithms ($\Phi_b$) evaluated at rational points, expressed via the Rogers and cyclic (quantum) dilogarithms and finite state-sums at roots of unity — the $\Phi_b$ state-integral face of the QOU odd-carrier / keystone root-of-unity work.
